Campbell & Company Investment Adviser Raised Par Pacific Holdings (PARR) Stake by $362,007; Gaming And Leisure Properties (GLPI) Holder Shikiar Asset Management Has Raised Stake by $427,165 as Stock Declined 
April 15, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Shikiar Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Gaming And Leisure Properties (GLPI) by 35.08% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Shikiar Asset Management Inc bought 11,545 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.45% with the market. The institutional investor held 44,455 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.65M, up from 32,910 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Shikiar Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Gaming And Leisure Properties for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.10B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.21% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $33.29. About 695,556 shares traded. Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. (NASDAQ:GLPI) has risen 2.70% since April 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.85% the S&P500. 
Campbell & Company Investment Adviser Llc increased its stake in Par Pacific Holdings Inc (PARR) by 114.36% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Campbell & Company Investment Adviser Llc bought 19,053 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.07% with the market. The hedge fund held 35,714 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $689,000, up from 16,661 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Campbell & Company Investment Adviser Llc who had been investing in Par Pacific Holdings Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $825.80M market cap company. The stock increased 1.63% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $18.08. About 87,286 shares traded. Par Pacific Holdings, Inc. (NYSEMKT:PARR) has risen 6.47% since April 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.08% the S&P500. 
Among 6 analysts covering Par Pacific ( NYSEMKT:PARR ), 4 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 67% are positive. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, October 6 by Mizuho. As per Thursday, January 28, the company rating was initiated by Imperial Capital. Sterne Agee CRT initiated the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, May 20 report. Seaport Global Securities initiated Par Pacific Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:PARR) rating on Thursday, September 8. Seaport Global Securities has “Buy” rating and $22 target. The stock has “Hold” rating by Miller Tabak on Monday, November 23. The stock of Par Pacific Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:PARR) has “Market Perform” rating given on Friday, June 10 by Cowen & Co.
